conventions.strips: horizontal; frame i at x = i*frameWidth, y = 0 (unless "grid" is given)
conventions.origin: Phaser setOrigin(x, y) fractions of one frame
conventions.zombies: 64x64 (brute 96x96, slime split / sprinter blasted_back+tumble 96x64), origin (0.5, 1.0) feet, facing east
conventions.bosses: 128x128, origin (0.5, 1.0), facing east; skill FX attach offsets are px from the boss origin, y up negative
conventions.pets: Chibi pets facing west; baby 48 / young 64 / ancient 96 (phoenix+dragon ancient 128); origin (0.5,1); skill = cast strip + standalone FX
conventions.hero: 92x92, origin (0.5, 76/92 = 0.8261) feet at y=76, facing west unless key ends in -walk-east/-north/-south
conventions.fx: origin per key; hero FX point west, boss FX east
conventions.loop: loop=true: whole strip repeats. loopFrom/loopTo (inclusive, 0-based): play [0,loopFrom) once, repeat [loopFrom..loopTo] while sustained, then (loopTo..end] once
conventions.environment: barricade posts 32x64, origin (0.5, 1.0) feet, gappy stakes (visual); collision stays code-driven
conventions.backgrounds: 1280x720, origin (0,0), top-left at world (832, 0) = fixed camera scrollX; depths far 3, fire 3.5, ground 4, mid 5, lamp 6
